hello. ok this is a very annoying bug i need you to track down. so pay attention, it has a very specific way it occurs.

so here is the game [Image #33] 

the game renders fine. 

when a file is updated, the app reloads, thats just react. when that happens. the game resets. and then looks like this. [Image #34] 

same game. thats good. except, if i turn my camera at all [Image #35] everything starts to disappear
resolution: Tracked the post-reload 'turn the camera and the world disappears' bug to the host retained-geometry intern caches. On dev hot reload only the V8 context is torn down and re-eval'd (v8_app.evalActiveTab -> clearTreeStateForReload), so the JS ship-once-per-key set (runtime/geometries/intern.ts) resets and re-ships verts, but the Zig host's append-only, never-evicting intern caches (g_geo_cache + the g_retained_vbuf bump cursor g_retained_top, plus the static-instance cache) persist and accumulate dead geometry from every prior map version across edit->reload cycles. Once they hit GEO_CACHE_SIZE/MAX_RETAINED_VERTS, internGeometry returns null and pass 1 silently drops the mesh; the shared Box geometry (grid + every building bucket) interns late, so grid + buildings vanish while props survive (matches the screenshots and the documented req_0725/0727 failure). Fix: new scene3d.resetForReload() rewinds the bump cursors and clears cache entries, exposed via gpu.scene3dResetForReload() and called from clearTreeStateForReload() (mirrors the JS resetShipped() that existed but was never wired); headless gpu stub got a no-op. Verification build of hmsc-int compiles clean. Needs the user to confirm live in tools/rjit dev hmsc-int since the trigger is hot-reload + camera input (not headless-reproducible).
